name.text: W02_Q01: Physical and Health Education JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: What is the primary difference between Health-Related Fitness and Skill-Related Fitness?

generalfeedback.text: Health-related fitness protects vital organ health and daily vitality; skill-related fitness develops motor skills for sports excellence.

answer.text: Health-Related Fitness focuses on overall bodily health and disease prevention, while Skill-Related Fitness enhances competitive athletic performance

feedback.text: Correct! Health-related fitness protects vital organ health and daily vitality; skill-related fitness develops motor skills for sports excellence.

answer.text: Health-Related Fitness is only for elderly people, while Skill-Related Fitness is only for babies

feedback.text: Incorrect. Health-related fitness protects vital organ health and daily vitality; skill-related fitness develops motor skills for sports excellence.

answer.text: Health-Related Fitness requires expensive gym weights, while Skill-Related Fitness requires no exercise

feedback.text: Incorrect. Health-related fitness protects vital organ health and daily vitality; skill-related fitness develops motor skills for sports excellence.

answer.text: Health-Related Fitness is tested with computer keyboards, while Skill-Related Fitness is tested with books

feedback.text: Incorrect. Health-related fitness protects vital organ health and daily vitality; skill-related fitness develops motor skills for sports excellence.

generalfeedback.text: The Reversibility principle states that fitness adaptations diminish when training stimulus is removed or discontinued.

generalfeedback.text: Fitness components are independent; an athlete can possess massive lifting strength while having stiff, inflexible joints.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Fitness components are independent; an athlete can possess massive lifting strength while having stiff, inflexible joints.

questiontext.text: Performing a light warm-up before intense physical conditioning increases muscle elasticity and significantly reduces the risk of muscle tears.

generalfeedback.text: Warm-up activities increase blood flow, warm muscle tissues, and lubricate joints, preventing acute strains and sprains.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Warm-up activities increase blood flow, warm muscle tissues, and lubricate joints, preventing acute strains and sprains.

name.text: W02_Q17: Physical and Health Education JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following components are classified under Health-Related Physical Fitness? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Cardiorespiratory endurance, muscular strength/endurance, and flexibility are health-related. Reaction time is a skill-related component.

name.text: W02_Q18: Physical and Health Education JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which two of the following components belong to the Skill-Related (Performance) Fitness family? (Select two)

generalfeedback.text: Agility and Power are skill-related fitness components. Body composition and resting heart rate relate to health fitness.

name.text: W02_Q19: Physical and Health Education JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each fitness component to its definition:

generalfeedback.text: Cardiorespiratory is heart/lungs; Strength is max force; Agility is changing direction; Flexibility is range of motion.

questiontext.text: Match each physical fitness test to the component it evaluates:

generalfeedback.text: Sit-and-Reach tests flexibility; Illinois tests agility; Push-up tests endurance; Ruler drop tests reaction time.
